object_description: three separate buildings linked by a broad connecting slab
design_condition: The three volumes are distributed across the stream and connected by a broad slab, but the extension encroaches on the planned playground and the resulting outdoor space is relatively shaded and ungenerous.

positive.statement: The project takes a sensitive and respectful approach to local traditions.

position.rationale: Distributed volumes and connecting slab are visible across the model, supporting a broad integration assessment.

positive.statement: The gymnasium is generously lit by natural light.

position.rationale: Gymnasium is not identifiable internally; upper western volume provides the most plausible spatial anchor.

positive.statement: The presentation of the project is convincing.

position.rationale: Presentation quality is a non-spatial judgment without a specific model location.

negative.statement: The extension encroaches substantially on the planned playground, contrary to the program.

position.rationale: The playground is not represented; the eastern lower open edge is used as a plausible encroachment zone.

negative.statement: The connecting outdoor space is relatively little sunny and not very generous.

position.rationale: The broad central connector and adjacent space are clearly visible between the separated volumes.

negative.statement: The dining area and kitchen lack natural light.

position.rationale: Interior functions are absent; the lower eastern volume provides a plausible constrained anchor.

negative.statement: The classroom arrangement produces downstream heights of four floors and does not respect the imposed regulations.

position.rationale: Stacked levels are evident in elevations, with the eastern volume anchoring the height concern.

negative.statement: The gallery distributing the retractable stands is relatively narrow.

position.rationale: The internal gallery is not distinguishable; the central connecting slab is the nearest circulation anchor.

negative.statement: The facade treatment seriously raises questions of maintenance and upkeep.

position.rationale: The exposed eastern edge is visible in plan and elevation, providing a facade maintenance anchor.

negative.statement: The jury questions whether the morphological aspects and materialization have been transcribed too literally despite differing programs and scales.

position.rationale: The comparison concerns the visible multi-volume composition and its material expression across the project.
